Private Function Seen(ws As Object, ByVal address As String) As String
    Dim c As Object, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range(address).Cells
        s = s & "," & c.Text
    Next
    Seen = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Fresh() As Object
    Set Fresh = Worksheets.Add
End Function

Private Sub Gone(ws As Object)
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    ws.Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
End Sub

sources.array 1x1 B2:B5:
Function Probe() As String
    Dim ws As Object, a() As Variant, r As Long, c As Long
    Set ws = Fresh()
    ReDim a(1 To 1, 1 To 1)
    For r = 1 To 1: For c = 1 To 1: a(r, c) = r * 10 + c: Next: Next
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Range("B2:B5").Value = a
    Probe = Err.Number & "!" & Seen(ws, "B2:E5")
    On Error GoTo 0
    Gone ws
End Function
